containment_policy.filesystem_read: native Read/Glob/Grep: run-owned project (including the installed package) only, refused elsewhere by permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories plus project-scoped permission rules and denied roots; Bash: sandboxed, host user/custody/run-state roots denied, immutable OS runtime reads only as needed by declared Bash families
containment_policy.filesystem_write: run-owned project only for native Write/Edit (project-scoped permission rules, no bare allow) and for Bash (sandbox allowWrite; CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB is disabled because scrub mode adds allowWrite for /home /root /tmp /var /opt /run /mnt); everything else, including /tmp outside the project, denied
containment_policy.protected_control_files: settings and strict qualification-owned MCP config live under the denied harness-private/runtime area outside the executor working directory; the executable shell prefix lives in the read-enabled, write-denied project .claude control directory and is hash-checked across launch; settings, config, and private MCP server executable are digest-checked across launch; the loaded project settings source is a fixed empty document, hooks are disabled, project .claude is write-denied and re-verified after execution
containment_policy.mediator_transport: qualification-owned dependency-free stdio MCP; no executor Unix socket or native network route
containment_policy.native_file_tools: run-project-scoped: the adapter alone grants Read/Edit/Write as permission rules scoped to the run project and sets permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories; a bare or path-argument Read/Glob/Grep/Edit/Write in native_allowed_tools is refused; a denied read root that contains the project is refused
containment_policy.runtime_created_entries: reviewed exact digest-bound set of entries the runtime still creates with scrub disabled: an empty .claude/.cc-writes directory (plus empty agents/commands directories); retained raw in runtime-created-entries.json; nothing is excluded from the final tree or diff; the scrub-mode start-up stub signature (17 named files) is INADMISSIBLE

credential_service_account_policy.parent_authentication: zero or one qualification-only auth source mapped explicitly for the Claude parent process
credential_service_account_policy.sandboxed_subprocess_credentials: deny (sandbox.credentials.envVars denies inherited credentials; a hash-bound Bash startup file removes credentials and runtime-added authenticated proxy variables before the Bash tool command; child environment is an explicit allow-list; MCP server runs under env -i)
